cohort: The study included preterm infants with a birth weight less than 1500g who were admitted to a hospital NICU between February 2017 and July 2019.
finding: Inadequate nutritional support for very low birth weight infants, primarily due to conservative enteral feeding practices, resulted in a high incidence of EUGR, with lower Z-score at birth and long cumulative enteral nutrition interruption time identified as risk factors.
